title:
Epic that updates `enableTopLeftBadges`, `enableTopRightBadges`, `enableBottomLeftBadges`, `enableBottomRightBadges`
fields, based on the payload value.

Expected payload:
- `mapId`: The {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMap} component id.
- `value`: List of {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapBadgesPositionType} values.
name: GeospatialChangeBadgeVisibilityEpic
